scope: Independent primary GitHub API commit/path/blob verification plus one bounded 1.286 MB raw download, 2012 AZ poll-only row comparison. No 2020 election outcomes used, no large download, no owner writes. Only this review JSON written.

primary_sources.timing_limit: GitHub primary history reports 2020-10-12T19:13:09Z, before the 2020 election. Git commit dates are recorded metadata, not independent trusted timestamps; no 2020 result data are needed for this finding.

arithmetic_checks.date_limit: Chen rows supply daysLeft, not a field interval or exact release date; conversion uses the known 2012 general election date.
arithmetic_checks.N_interpretation: Chen samplesize 500 and candidate values 220/250 are directly observed archive fields. Tierney numberOfRespondents 470 equals D+R. This supports a two-party denominator interpretation and is compatible with dropping 6% other/undecided; it does not prove an actual respondent-count transformation or a separate N470 survey.

proved: The saved Chen bytes exactly match the raw GitHub content at the named commit and Git blob, including Git object framing hash.
The archive contains one selected Arizona 2012 Rasmussen -16 pair with explicit Flake/Carmona identifiers, N500 and R250/D220.

Literal Tierney source CSV line3318 contains AZ2012 same pollster/date, D220/R250 and numberOfRespondents470; the selected prepared row preserves those fields. Source_row_number3318 means CSV line number including header, not zero-based row index.
The observed fields are arithmetically compatible with the publisher/538 44/50 result and a two-party conditioning operation.
not_proved: No source transformation script, literal upstream row foreign key, original questionnaire identifier, respondent/sample identity, field start or chain of custody from this Chen pair to Tierney line3318 has been established here.
Candidate names are explicit in Chen but absent from the literal Tierney row; prepared candidate identities come from a later roster join.
Same state/cycle/pollster/date and exact derived values strongly constrain a candidate link, but do not authenticate common respondents, release, fieldwork or the actual transformation.
The October2020 Chen archive cannot establish original 2012 publication timing or the historical vintage of the March2023 Tierney file.
lineage_assessment.claim_to_use: Strong content-compatible source-lineage candidate; transformation and physical poll identity remain unverified.
lineage_assessment.claim_to_reject: Verified Tierney transformation from the N500 release solely because 220+250=470, or treating N470 as original poll respondent N.

reproduction: Use GitHub git/commits and contents endpoints above; compute SHA1(b"blob "+ASCII(byte_length)+b"\0"+raw_bytes); compare raw bytes. Filter Chen cycle2012/stateArizona/pollsterRasmussen/daysLeft-16. Filter Tierney year2012/stateAZ/endDate2012-10-21/pollNameRasmussen, retaining poll fields only. No outcome columns are required.
